description: Run this project's wired PHP static-analysis and coding-style tools — PHPStan (including Larastan, `szepeviktor/phpstan-wordpress`, and PrestaShop's `prestashop/php-dev-tools` config, honoring the project's baseline) with `--error-format=json`, Psalm (`--output-format=json`), Laravel Pint (`--test` with a JSON report file), PHP-CS-Fixer (`check`/`fix --dry-run --diff --format=json`), PHP_CodeSniffer (`phpcs --report=json` with whatever standards `phpcs.xml(.dist)` references — WordPress/WordPress-Extra/WordPress-Docs, PHPCompatibilityWP, PSR12, PER), and Rector (`process --dry-run --output-format=json`) when configured — then report every issue found (file, line, rule id/identifier, message), grouped by tool and classified by rule id. Detects the project's flavor (Laravel application, WordPress plugin or theme, PrestaShop module, or plain Composer library) from `composer.json` and file markers (`artisan`, a `Plugin Name:` header, `style.css` `Theme Name:`/`theme.json`, a class that `extends Module`/`config.xml`) to know which tools to expect and which rule-id prefixes matter, and verifies each tool is actually installed and configured before trusting a "zero issues" result from it. Runs through whichever environment the project uses for PHP (host `php`, Laravel Sail, ddev, or wp-env). Invoke as `/iru-php-code-quality` to check the whole project, or `/iru-php-code-quality <path-or-glob>` to scope the run and the report — every one of these tools accepts paths, so a scoped invocation narrows what actually runs. When the prompt supplies a baseline (a prior per-rule-id issue count from an earlier run of this skill, e.g. captured by `iru-php-code-one-task-group` before a task group's changes), reports only the new-vs-baseline diff per rule id. Report-only: never fixes issues or edits tool configuration. Use whenever the user wants a static-analysis/style pass called out separately from `iru-php-test`/`iru-php-coverage`, instead of eyeballing `composer lint` output.
